itens.titulo: Banco Central vende US$ 2 bilhões em leilão em meio à pressão sobre o dólar
itens.descricao: Banco Central vende US$ 2 bilhões em leilão em meio à pressão sobre o dólar Money Times
itens.texto:
Banco Central vende US$ 2 bilhões em leilão em meio à pressão sobre o dólar
O Banco Central vendeu nesta manhã de quarta-feira o total de US$2 bilhões em dois leilões de linha (venda de dólares com compromisso de recompra) realizados simultaneamente.
No leilão de linha A, com data de recompra para 2 de abril de 2027, o BC não aceitou propostas.
No leilão de linha B, a taxa de corte foi de 6,177700% e foram aceitas duas propostas no total de US$2 bilhões. A venda de moeda será liquidada em 30 de novembro de 2026, enquanto a recompra ocorrerá em 2 de julho de 2027.
Ao promover leilões de linha, o Banco Central dá liquidez ao mercado à vista em um momento de forte pressão de alta para o dólar, em meio às preocupações dos investidores com a política fiscal do governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
Nos últimos meses de cada ano, o BC também costuma realizar leilões de linha para irrigar a liquidez em função das tradicionais remessas de recursos pelas multinacionais ao exterior.

itens.titulo: Nvidia, AMD, and Micron stocks sink as investors flee AI trade
itens.descricao: Nvidia, AMD, and Micron stocks sink as investors flee AI trade Yahoo Finance
trechos: Nvidia (NVDA) stock retreated another 5% on Wednesday, following a 6% decline in the prior session as chip stocks continued to plunge amid a broader market sell-off.
This year's once-hot AI trades continue to tumble, with memory chipmaker Micron Technology (MU) and peer SK Hynix (SKHY) dropping 6%.
Micron is 50% off its all-time high over the summer.
Sandisk, which recently implemented a stock split, is roughly 70% off its June record high.
The violent move follows a stunning rally on Monday when Nvidia jumped 31% after the AI chip giant's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO.

"There is still a lot of nervousness out there, and some investors have taken advantage of Monday's jump to cut their exposure to the AI trade," said David Morrison, senior market analyst at Trade Nation, on Wednesday.

itens.titulo: PETR4: Santander rebaixa ações da Petrobras para neutra com percepção maior de risco
itens.descricao: PETR4: Santander rebaixa ações da Petrobras para neutra com percepção maior de risco InfoMoney
trechos: Para os American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), o preço-alvo passou de US$ 24 para US$ 18,35 (+17,10% ante o último fechamento).
Segundo o banco, embora o novo Plano de Negócios 2027-31 indique produção mais robusta, ele também eleva a percepção de risco.

Há ainda incerteza sobre a manutenção da política de preços de combustíveis, que pode ser revista em breve, além de dúvidas quanto ao imposto de 12% sobre exportação de petróleo e a eventuais subsídios aos combustíveis.
O Santander calcula yield ordinário de dividendos em torno de 9% para 2027, assumindo Brent a US$ 80 o barril.

Na avaliação do banco, esse nível não compensa os riscos adicionais, sobretudo porque grandes petroleiras globais oferecem retorno médio de cerca de 8% aos acionistas com menor risco de alocação de capital.

Continua depois da publicidade Os analistas Yuri Pereira, Eduardo Muniz e Nicole Alonso destacam que a produção doméstica de petróleo é projetada em cerca de 2,9 milhões de barris por dia entre 2027 e 2031, alinhada ao plano da companhia.
O relatório vê espaço para surpresas positivas, graças à redução da taxa de declínio de alguns ativos para 3% e à possibilidade de aumento nominal de capacidade.
O banco estima capex de caixa de US$ 25 bilhões anuais em 2027-2028, recuando para US$ 16 bilhões em 2031 – cerca de US$ 1 bilhão acima do plano por ano.

itens.titulo: Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) esclarece à CVM sobre provisões do agro
itens.descricao: Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) esclarece à CVM sobre provisões do agro Suno - Investimentos Inteligentes
trechos: Mercado Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) esclarece à CVM sobre provisões do agro O Banco do Brasil (BBAS3) divulgou, em 24 de novembro de 2026, comunicado ao mercado em resposta ao Ofício nº 319/2026/CVM/SEP/GEA-1, da Comissão de Valores Mobiliários.

O documento trata de esclarecimentos sobre notícia veiculada pelo jornal Folha de São Paulo, no dia 17 de novembro de 2026, sob o título ‘BB quer negociar com BC regra mais flexível para registrar perdas com agro’.

A CVM concedeu ao banco prazo adicional de resposta por meio do Ofício nº 323/2026/CVM/SEP/GEA-1, de 18 de novembro de 2026, com vencimento em 24 de novembro de 2026, mesma data do comunicado ao mercado.
O ofício da CVM também alertou que o não cumprimento da exigência poderia resultar em multa cominatória de R$ 1.000,00, sem prejuízo de outras sanções administrativas previstas na regulamentação.

itens.titulo: Palantir’s CEO Alex Karp Sold $75 Million. Co-Founder Peter Thiel Bought $122 Million
itens.descricao: Palantir’s CEO Alex Karp Sold $75 Million. Co-Founder Peter Thiel Bought $122 Million Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - Palantir co-founder Peter Thiel bought $122 million of stock while CEO Alex Karp sold $75 million, but preset rules drove most of both trades.
- Thiel's plan bought on a 7% selloff near the day's low, and his average price sat below his March sale price.
- Palantir trades at 229 times earnings while contract value grew just 6%, leaving little room for error despite revenue nearly doubling.
Two well-known insiders traded in opposite directions on the same Friday, and their Form 4s were filed together after the close on Tuesday evening, November 24.
Co-founder and director Peter Thiel bought 850,100 Class A shares of Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR) on November 20 for about $122.3 million.
CEO Alex Karp sold 493,263 shares across November 20 and 23 for about $75.1 million.
Thiel's purchases ran under a Rule 10b5-1 plan he adopted on August 19, 2026.
About 82% of Karp's proceeds went to cover tax withholding on vested restricted stock units.

- Palantir trades at 229 times earnings while contract value grew just 6%, leaving little room for error despite revenue nearly doubling.

itens.titulo: Unilever, BAT and Reckitt named among JPMorgan’s top picks for 2027
itens.descricao: Unilever, BAT and Reckitt named among JPMorgan’s top picks for 2027 Yahoo Finance UK
trechos: It forecasts overall European staples EPS growth of 6% to 7% in 2027, with tobacco, ingredients and soft drinks leading at 8% to 9%.
Beer is expected to deliver growth of around 5%, while food and household and personal care businesses are forecast to achieve 6% to 7%.
Unilever and Reckitt also feature among the bank's eight preferred stocks for 2027, alongside Nestlé, Puig, Kerry Group, Danone (OTCQX:DANOY) and Carlsberg.
JPMorgan cautioned that recent gains have made the sector less attractive on valuation, with European staples trading on 19 times forward earnings against a long-term average of 18 times.
The bank also warned that restrained pricing and higher input costs could squeeze margins, although a lower oil price could provide some relief in the second half of 2027.

itens.titulo: Is Google Services Still the Prime Earnings Engine for Alphabet Stock?
itens.descricao: Is Google Services Still the Prime Earnings Engine for Alphabet Stock? Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: In the third quarter of 2026, the segment generated revenues of $96.3 billion, up 11% year over year, out of Alphabet's total revenues of $127.6 billion.
More importantly, segment operating income increased $5.6 billion to $39.2 billion, with operating margin at 40.7%.
By comparison, Google Cloud posted operating income of $11.1 billion, underscoring that Services still generates the bulk of Alphabet's segment profits despite Cloud's rapid ascent.
Fundamentally, Search & other revenues rose 12% to $63.4 billion, with year-over-year query growth at a five-year high, aided by AI-powered features.
Subscriptions, platforms and devices revenues grew 11% to $14.3 billion, driven by YouTube Music and Premium, which crossed 150 million subscribers, including trials and AI plans in Google One.
To deepen monetization, Google expanded ads in AI Mode to 10 new markets, including India, on Oct.
28, 2026, brought multi-turn ads to the United States and plans to add Brazil, Mexico and the U.K.
Search growth decelerated from 15% in the year-ago quarter, hurt by foreign exchange, normalization in ad spending after the FIFA World Cup and lower monetization of AI Mode queries.

itens.titulo: AMD Sees Server Revenues Doubling in 2027: Will the Momentum Last?
itens.descricao: AMD Sees Server Revenues Doubling in 2027: Will the Momentum Last? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. AMD is anticipated to enter 2027 with strong momentum in its server business.
The company expects server revenues to double year over year in 2027, reflecting rising demand for EPYC processors across cloud, enterprise and artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure markets.
The company's third-quarter 2026 Data Center revenues surged 97% year over year to a record $8.5 billion.
Advanced Micro Devices started shipping Venice in the third quarter, with more than 240 platforms committed by original equipment manufacturers and original design manufacturers.
This is 20% higher than the platform commitments for the previous Turin generation.
Cloud providers have also started deploying Venice ahead of broader availability planned for early 2027.
The company estimates that the server market could reach approximately $220 billion by 2030.
The Zacks Consensus Estimate for AMD's 2026 and 2027 revenues indicates a year-over-year increase of 50.5% and 81.4%, respectively.

itens.titulo: Nvidia Stock Looks Like a Screaming Buy Below $160. Here's Why.
itens.descricao: Nvidia Stock Looks Like a Screaming Buy Below $160. Here's Why. Yahoo Finance
trechos: Nvidia stock jumped 31% in a single day as investors welcomed the return of the man who built Nvidia into the dominant artificial intelligence (AI) chip company.
Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005.
But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase.
"Act 2" is the global rollout.
Nvidia is trading a little above $150 at this writing, and several Wall Street analysts think there's plenty of money left to be made.
That's why I believe that Nvidia is a screaming buy at less than $160.
And even the most conservative price target among them represents a healthy gain over Nvidia's closing price of $165.05 that day.
StoneX has a "buy" rating with a $270 price target, while Oppenheimer is close behind with a $250 price target.
